HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

2. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   C. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.

3. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

5. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   B. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   B. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

9. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   B. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   D. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Public Participation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Elections in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain National integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

3. A — Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A — Explain symbols used on a map

5. D — Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. B — Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. B — Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. D — Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. D — Nairobi

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Public Participation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elections in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of National integration; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
